statement: The new Upgrade Vault update is accessed from the quick ref menu.
Upgrade Vault is like the Death Bringer grimoire but upgraded with money instead of bones.
You start with one upgrade unlocked; reaching a certain number of upgrades unlocks the next ones.
Some strong players could max the vault on day one but most upgrades target different (less advanced) players.
Vault is a saving grace for early game players covering damage class XP talent points defense and accuracy.
Worlds 1 to 3 progression is different now; vault gives lots of stats for little investment as a catch-up mechanic.
New money percent bonuses might fix the early game lack of money problem.
Biggest early vault upgrades are defense and accuracy; put about 90% of your money into the shield and target upgrades.
World 1 town stamps still boost defense and accuracy but vault gives 30-40 points for the price of a few stamp levels; useful through World 3.
Vault also increases the potency of the defense and accuracy stamps.
Vault has bonuses for Orion feathers and anvil production speed to fast-track mega feathers and gear crafting.
Vault includes quality of life upgrade for movement speed to get around maps quicker.
Three attack talent enhancers make MP usage more efficient and make WHL? very strong on Warriors.
Vault has money percent statue bonuses and class XP useful for mid and end gamers to gain Death Bringer talent points.
Vault forge capacity is less important now that the Hole gives forge cap upgrades but could trivialize crafting Godard? gear without investing in that.
If forge cap keeps rising we could eventually smelt billions of ore in a single 2-minute claim.
New fractal island bonus gives 2% sneaking per sneaking level; ranks name garbled.
Update added the ability to craft from quick ref.
Lava gave a free permanent 30% AFK gain rate for all activities.
Max Vault Mastery gives another 30% AFK gain rate for a total 60% AFK gain increase in the update.
Bug fix: tombstone sometimes not spotting for Death Bringer.
Bug fix: Monument not giving its full multiplier of bonuses.
Lava teased the next five months: two more master classes cavern expansions the world 6 boss and a companion rework.
Lava mentioned a big announcement coming in a few days.
Lava changed boss farming again and it is now not working due to exploiters and auto clickers.
Proposes an NPC daily quest: spend 300 keys for 200 gems and remove boss gems entirely.
Argues the daily key quest would increase player activity and help normal players instead of punishing them.
Suggests a streak reward: 5 days of the 300 key quest gives 5 gem envelopes with a small chance at 10000 gems.
The daily key quest must not be affected by golden pocket watches.
